'''Brian Cano''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 83 from Staten Island, Ny. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He started playing in 1995 and was a tournament director before joining the squadron. He ran Young Jedi demos at Star Wars Celebration in Denver (1999) and attended DecipherCon in Virginia Beach.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
It was a rainy weekend in 1995 when I bought my first starter deck and booster pack of the new Star Wars CCG.  I liked the Star Trek CCG prior to it, and was hopeful for this game.  In the starter deck I got Han Solo, and in the booster pack I got Darth Vader.  WOW.  What a start.
And the rest as they say, is history.  Player, tournament director, Squadron member....complete the progression please. =)
All I can say is that I've had an incredible time during my "tour of duty"; good times, great people - I can recall another rainy weekend in Denver at the Star Wars Celebration.  We were soaked to the bone, but all gathered had a great time meeting each other and running Young Jedi demos.  Ironically, just over a week later, I found myself standing in the pouring rain waiting to get into the theatre to see Episode I (anyone see a pattern forming here?).  Thank the Maker it was mostly dry in Virginia Beach for Deciphercon!  Now THAT was a great time!
So, whenever you find yourself in the Coruscant Region, feel free to give me a shout.  Oh, and don't forget your umbrella! =)

Beware the Dark Side...<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
